title: Echolot
description: MIDI/CV delay with feedback and pitch shift
text:
Echolot is a MIDI/CV delay with feedback, mix, and optional pitch shift on each repeat.

### Cheatsheet

Delay with feedback and optional pitch intervals. I/O picks MIDI/CV routing; Ping-Pong alternates MIDI Out A/B (MIDI→MIDI and CV→MIDI). Mute = ring-out (block new input; queue plays out). Long Panic clears the trail — Third interval edits never panic that hold. MIDI In always flashes white for diagnosis when muted.

**Faders**

- **Main** — Delay (up = shorter / faster)

**Buttons**

- **Long** — Panic (clear queue); skipped if Third used this hold

**LEDs**

- White flash on MIDI/gate in (~20% when muted)
- Ping-Pong: Top = Out A · Bottom = Out B

**Params**

- Routing: Single / Ping-Pong

channels.jackDescription: Role depends on I/O and Signal params.
